Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We regret to inform you that your application has been rejected.

The main reasons are: hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, JAGS or similar) is not found in your CV; experience with Amazon SageMaker is missing; experience with PySpark is missing; strong working knowledge of SQL is missing.

You may reply to this message with questions if you would like to request a human review of this decision.

Kind regards
